tickets.name: Center Circle
tickets.note: Lights up for Wizards at Cavaliers, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! It starts with Allen against Davis at center court, and our money says Allen gets up there first! Advantage Cavaliers for the opening bucket. When the Cavaliers come down for the first time, Watson is the one we're watching! Should the Wizards grab the first possession, Davis is our trigger man! Any one of them hits and the whole game is paid for. That's how we like it!

tickets.name: Win the Tip

So the Heat should get the first crack at it. Give Adebayo the tip and he's sprinting to the block. Feed the big man! Thompson is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! If the Hawks get there first, Okongwu is who we want firing! One bucket from any of them and we're cashing. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

And Powell is the second option on that same trip, and the price is a beauty! Every one of our picks is a way to win the opening bucket, and every one of them cashes!

Bailey is the lone value in this one, and we are HERE for it!

And if the Mavericks flip the script, Gafford is waiting right there to pounce! The stakes are split so any one of them pays for the whole game. Beautiful!
